# casino-calculator

Compare theoretical gambling costs using turnover, RTP and fixed fees. Transparent casino calculator, worked examples and a clear explanation of uncertainty.

## Main page
- [casino calculator](https://bonsaionlinecas-sys.github.io/casino-calculator/): Compare theoretical gambling costs using turnover, RTP and fixed fees. Transparent casino calculator, worked examples and a clear explanation of uncertainty.

## Method and scope
One self-contained page with an interactive tool, visible worked examples, limitations and questions. No accounts or financial transactions. Inputs are processed locally in the browser.
